change.description: Add boolean expiry metadata to scheduler command batches while retaining the existing inbox handoff. Review the producer and its supplied decoding boundary for actionable defects. See PROJECT.md for the wire contract.

context_manifest.content:
# Command handoff

The scheduler serializes enumerate_commands output and sends those exact bytes
through claim_commands to an inbox. The codec is invoked before the inbox is
changed. It enforces the supplied exact value types; annotations alone are not
runtime validation. There is no alternate decoder or intervening coercion.

Records have string id/command and integer created_at (epoch seconds).
reference_time is an integer at or after created_at. The new expired metadata
must be a JSON boolean, including false for work at most 900 seconds old.
Both flags must reach the inbox unchanged. Legacy string-only maps and empty
batches remain accepted. Numeric, null, list and object field values must still
be rejected. The codec's map contract permits any string keys; field-specific
validation is outside this handoff. Everything runs locally with Python's
standard library; no activity framework or service is required.
